lines.text: Eli's sons were wicked; the servant's fork went into the pot and the priest claimed whatever came up.
The servant demanded raw meat for the priest, and the young men treated the LORD's offering with contempt.
Each year Hannah brought Samuel a little sash, and the LORD gave her three sons and two daughters.
A man of God told Eli the LORD chose his father as priest, yet Eli honored his sons more.
The sign for Eli was that his sons Hophni and Eleazar would both die on the same day.
